readout_other: Multi-channel silicon electrode spikes and LFP; intrinsic optical signal imaging of HbT
direction_notes: TUS increased the firing rate of putative inhibitory and excitatory neurons and HbT, and increased neurovascular coupling strength; relative gamma power increased and alpha power decreased.

timing.protocol_description: Stimulation duration 700 ms, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 50%; ultrasound stimulation at 10-s intervals and the mean over eight trials was computed.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Eighteen male C57BL/6 wild-type mice, weighing 20–25 g (sourced from Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd), were used for this study. The experimental protocols were approved by the Animal Ethics and Administrative Council of Yanshan University. The subjects were accommodated in standard cages and maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle with ad libitum access to food and water.
